SELECT l.ID, l.SOURCE_TYPE, l.EXTERNAL_ID, l.MASTER_ID, l.NAME, l.CATEGORY, l.DEPARTMENT, l.CURRENT_PROMULGATION_NO, l.CURRENT_PROMULGATION_DATE, l.CURRENT_ENFORCEMENT_DATE, l.DETAIL_LINK, l.IS_ACTIVE, l.LAST_SYNCED_AT, l.CREATED_AT, l.UPDATED_AT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DOC_LAW_MAPPINGS m WHERE m.TRACKED_LAW_ID = l.ID) AS MAPPED_DOCUMENT_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LAW_REVISIONS r WHERE r.TRACKED_LAW_ID = l.ID AND r.REVIEW_STATUS = '미검토') AS UNREVIEWED_REVISION_COUNT FROM TRACKED_LAWS l WHERE l.ID = #{id}
